posts.text:
Trump moved to the center relative to Romney on Medicare privatization and stuff like Don’t Ask Don’t Tell and marriage equality. 

That’s smart politics. The idea that it had to be paired with also being a historically corrupt sociopath doesn’t make any sense.

This is also the flipside of a point I keep urging on Democrats about the importance of policy. 

Mitt Romney *really is* a nice guy and thoughtful and exhibits real wisdom and moral courage, but he chose to run on the most hard-right platform of any candidate ever.


🏳️‍🌈Mar G-O 🌐🇺🇦 (@MariGO2thepolls)

It’s crazy that it’s basically center right doctrine at this point that Obama was t supposed to campaign against Romney. He was supposed to give him the white horse because Mitt asked nicely. Wha

I don’t think you find any countries building a more egalitarian economy on the basis of premium wages to public services providers, it’s always some combination of broad redistribution and compressed private sector wage scales.
Trump fixed the vibecession by pushing real wage growth below zero so there’s no longer any mystery as to why people are so angry.

Trump keeps sabotaging bipartisan permitting talks with his endless crusade against utility-scale wind and solar projects. 

slowboring.com/p/trumps-chin…

In addition to its long-range commuter function, a properly managed LIRR ought to offer a layer of urban rapid transit to Brooklyn and Queens comparable to Paris RER or Berlin S-Bahn but that requires operational efficiency to unlock higher frequencies and lower fares.

"Buy Apple stock"


Tears (@x__Tears__x)

China is the topic on which Trump has gotten the most underserved praise for an incoherent approach

Trump’s China policy is a total disaster: 

— Picking irrelevant trade battles with friendly countries 
— Giving away the store on advanced chips 
— Derailing American energy with a perverse crusade against wind and solar

Embarrassing performance by the Pistons

Beyond the specifics of the contract, running MetroNorth and LIRR as two entirely separately entities with different work rules and even different policies on whether “railroad” is one word or two is an absurd practice by the MTA and New York State.

Some of the smartest people I know in politics are developing elaborate rouses to trick Democrats into viewing accurate information about American politics because they believe stating facts plainly would just mobilize the progressive white blood cells to block it.

Can’t believe the American accents in The Odyssey trailer. Characters should be speaking with English accents just like real Bronze Age Greeks.

Most voters are way more eclectic and less coherent than the kinds of people who obsess about politics, but there are still pretty clear patterns to anyone with their eyes open.

There is a lot of pandemic risk out there and a lot we could and should be doing to mitigate it but years after COVID struck we’ve done basically nothing to set ourselves up for success.
